$comment: FORM P5 admission, 2026-11-18. The honest limits are written into twice.note and enforced.note. mapSpec.tiles is NOT admitted (no model sets it).
keyword: screens[] map, countdown and dashboard widgets

declarative.why: a map is where two fields are; a dashboard is tiles (an expression each), charts (a field to group by) and embedded screens; a countdown is the expiry field of an inbox row

notLower.why: widget values are server-side aggregates evaluated through /api/x/eval under the caller's access, and the map/countdown/SSE behaviour is client runtime the platform ships; none of it is expressible in a flow or function

twice.note: ONE APP ONLY: ride-hailing, but several distinct demands there -- map on ride-now (pickPoints), my-ride/active-ride (route), drivers-map (center me), tiles + table + map + chart widgets on dispatch-board, countdown on the driver offers inbox. widget.chart/groupBy got their use on 2026-11-18. No second app yet.

enforced.note: BROWSER-PROVEN ONLY: the ride-hailing browser stage (23/23) and the real-browser smoke (9/9) drove map, countdown, live and the dashboard, and experience-client.test.mjs (60 node tests) covers the renderers; ExperienceValidationTest checks lat/lng/groupBy against the concept; /api/x/eval has probe 20. There is no behaviour probe of a map, a countdown or a chart. The `probe` path above is the ride-hailing exposure matrix, which only pins the routes.

taught.bundleLine: Maps: `"map":{"lat":"pickupLat","lng":"pickupLng","label":"..","center":"me","tiles":"<property>","pickPoints":{..}}` ... Screen extras: `countdown` (inbox rows that expire), `widgets:[{"kind":"tile|chart|table|map|list","title":"..","value":"count(..)","screen":"<screen>","groupBy":"status","chart":"bar|line|donut","span":2}]`
